prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE character concept asset sheet for an original vegetable-themed 2D platformer. True transparent PNG alpha background. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match its polished 32-bit-era 2D pixel art, crisp dark contours, warm readable shading, expressive eyes, controlled fine pixel clusters. Do NOT copy its potato anatomy, scarf or boots onto unrelated species. No text, title, labels, borders, swatches, floor, cast shadow, landscape, paper, checkerboard or matte. All blank space alpha=0. Opaque interiors with clean alpha edges; no general glow. Not vector, not 3D, no soft painting. Six separate complete figures in a generous 3-column by 2-row layout. No overlap between poses, at least 10% transparent gutters, keep every limb and particle within its cell. These are key-pose CONCEPTS, not animation frames; scale and grid fitting will be done later. Maintain exact same design identity between poses.
Character E09: 棉花云牧者. Ingredient: 棉花与棉桃. Silhouette MUST follow: 蓬松棉团托着棉桃脸，两片苞叶像扶手. Palette: 暖白／青灰／褐绿.
Behavior context: 空中横向跟随，定时投下E04；同屏其生成的刺栗最多3只. Readable counterplay: 借高台踩踏；火弹. Danger cue: 投掷前0.6秒抬手；禁止在玩家身上直接生成刺栗.
Show SIX ordered poses: front three-quarter idle, side movement, back silhouette, primary special behavior, alternative state, non-gory hurt pose. Required behavioral states to communicate across these poses: 跟随→抬手→投掷→冷却. For simple swimmers or walkers use distinct movement anticipation and action. Show cotton boll creature on a compact cotton puff, not goggles or a turtle riding a weather cloud.
Preserve recognizable edible plant anatomy and game-readable contours. All figures isolated on actual transparent alpha.
STRICT: Do not invent attacks not specified. No fire/chili/stars except tiny hurt marks. For flying cabbage, reference 2 is its exact base anatomy; add leaf wings, preserve base face/root feet.
review: 待修订：投掷物应为刺栗，当前像棉桃。
